chunks: 4982 - The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ascended the pulpit and said:
"Three Allah will not speak to on the Day of Judgment, nor will He look at them... nor will He purify them, and for them is a painful punishment."
An old man who commits adultery, a tyrannical king, and a poor person who is arrogant.

key_terms.شَيْخٌ زَانٍ: an elderly man who commits adultery
key_terms.عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ: a painful punishment in the hereafter
key_terms.مُقِلٌّ مُخْتَالٌ: a poor person who behaves arrogantly
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when all people are brought to account

ai.seo_question: Which kinds of people does Allah not speak to on the Day of Judgment according to this hadith?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم warns of three especially blameworthy types of people who face severe punishment on the Day of Judgment. The hadith condemns adultery in old age, tyranny in rulership, and arrogance in poverty as grave moral failings with eschatological consequences.
